name: Greptile
description: Review GitHub and GitLab pull requests with full-codebase context, then fetch and fix review comments from Claude Code, Cursor or Codex via MCP or the CLI, for engineering teams.

skills.name: Review Pull Request
skills.description: Triggers a Greptile code review on a GitHub or GitLab pull request, then returns the review once the analysis finishes.

skills.name: Fix Review Comments
skills.description: Fetches a pull request's unaddressed Greptile review comments so a coding agent can apply the suggested fixes.

skills.name: Search Review Comments
skills.description: Searches past Greptile review comments across repositories to find recurring issues and earlier feedback.

skills.name: Manage Coding Standards
skills.description: Views, searches and creates custom context, turning recurring review feedback into coding patterns Greptile enforces.

skills.name: Review Locally
skills.description: Reviews local branches from the terminal with the Greptile CLI before you push, or in CI with an API key.
